_doc: Retail listings for Equihash ASICs. Prices, stock and shipping are copied from the vendor product page (never invented). n/a is null, never 0. shop_hashrate_ksol is what the shop states; manufacturer specs stay on /miners. image paths are relative to static/. equihash.com never checkouts — every CTA is an outbound product_url.

listings.title: Bitmain Antminer Z15 Pro 860KSol
listings.hashrate_note: Shop states 860 kSol; Bitmain's typical published figure is 840 kSol (see Hardware).
listings.shipping_note: Free UK delivery (schema shippingRate £0 to GB). DDP UK/EU warehouse; duties and taxes included per shop copy. Handling 1–3 business days; transit 2–10 days.
